scope: Partial artifact-content audit of the production web package and five local JavaScript SDK tarballs only. Native installables, desktop installers, redistribution terms and final release acceptance remain open; K12 is not complete.
environment: macOS 26.5.2 arm64; Node 24.14.0; local build and npm pack only

web.checks: Manifest source revision and clean tree matched; every copied file size and SHA256 matched; required model, WASM, worker, server and license/notice assets were present; private filenames, private-key PEM markers and the local workspace path were absent. Brotli, gzip and Zstandard assets decoded to their plain siblings on this Node 24 run.

sdk.checks: Each tarball SHA256 matched its manifest; extracted file paths, sizes and SHA256 values matched every package inventory with no extra files or links; each package carried LICENSE, README.md and package.json; no private-key PEM marker or local workspace path was found.

regression: Both embedded private-key text and a local workspace path in an otherwise allowed web file, plus a mismatched compressed asset, were accepted by the previous packager and rejected by the candidate; 14/14 focused packaging tests pass.
gates: npx tsc --noEmit; npm run lint (0 errors, one existing warning); npm run test:unit (907/907); node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs (33/33); node tools/audit-platform-records.mjs
